DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は、自分の外見のことで悩んだことある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 急にどうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……先生も知ってる通り私、よく第一印象が怖いって言われるから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 変なのに絡まれることも多いし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そのおかげで得したことも……あんまり無いし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、前に探してほしいって言ってたの、ようやく手に入ったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: やった、ありがとう！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その反応、相当探してたんだね。なら良かった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日の午後にでも、もし時間があったら便利屋に寄って受け取っていって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: シャーレの仕事が終わったら、すぐに行くね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は、好きな音楽のジャンルとかある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ポップスかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: クラシックかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そっか、まあ似合ってると思う

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: カヨコはどんな音楽が好きなの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私は……まあ、普通のやつ。先生と結構好み近いかも

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あの2ndアルバム、聞き終わった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ブラック・デス・ポイズン、最高じゃない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……脳にガツン！って来る感じだった

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……アバンギャルドな感じだった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さすが、先生なら分かってくれると思った

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 2ndアルバムは1stアルバムに比べて歌詞は分かりやすくなったけど、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: サウンドはますます激しくなってるから、こっちの方が好きって人は多くて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もし気に入ったなら、今度3rdアルバムを貸してあげる

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 考えとくね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 天気予報で、今日の午後は雨だって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 傘、忘れないようにね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: トリニティに世界中の全ての本を集めた巨大な図書館があるらしいけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 世界中のレコードを集めたレコード屋とか、どこかにないのかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 商店街の「ザ・レコードビル」とかは？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あそこも世界中ってわけじゃないけど……品揃えは確かに悪くない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ジャンルを問わず、色々なレコードが集められてるから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 休みの日とか、よく行く

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생은 인상 때문에 고민해 본 경험 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 왜 갑자기 그런 생각을 한 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그게…… 선생도 알다시피 내 인상이 좀 사나운 편이잖아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러다 보니 이상하게 시비가 걸리는 일이 잦아서 말이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 인상이 사나워서 좋은 일은 별로 없는 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생, 전에 구해달라고 의뢰했던 물건이 방금 들어왔어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 오, 드디어 들어왔구나!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후, 반응을 보니 오랫동안 기대했던 물건인가 보네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오후에 시간 되면 우리 흥신소에 들러서 찾아가.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 샬레의 일이 끝나면 바로 찾아갈게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생은 특별히 즐겨 듣는 음악 장르가 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 대중가요려나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 클래식이려나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그렇구나. 무난한 편이네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 카요코는 어떤 음악을 좋아해?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나도, 뭐…… 평범한 걸 좋아해서. 선생이랑 음악 취향은 비슷할 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생, 내가 추천해 준 2집 앨범은 다 들었어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어때, 역시 블랙 데스 포이즌의 곡은 최고지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……뭔가 인상적이었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……뭔가 전위적이었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 선생은 그 곡의 진가를 알아보는구나. 다행이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 2집 앨범은 1집 앨범에 비해 가사는 많이 순화되었지만,

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 사운드가 거칠어서 진짜 헤비메탈 팬들은 이쪽을 더 좋아하는 편이지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 블랙 데스 포이즌의 2집이 마음에 들었다면 이번에는 3집을 빌려줄게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 헤비메탈은 이제 괜찮아…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생, 일기예보를 보니 오늘 오후에는 비가 온다고 하네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘은 출근할 때 잊지 말고 우산 챙겨가.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 트리니티에는 세상의 모든 책을 모아 놓은 거대한 도서관이 있다고 하는데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 세상의 모든 음반을 모아 놓은 음반 매장은 어디 없으려나?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 키보토스 상점가에 있는 <레코드 빌딩>은 어때?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 세상의 모든 음반이 있는 건 아니지만…… 레코드 빌딩 정도면 나쁘지 않지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 장르를 불문한 다양한 음반을 모아 놓고 있으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나도 휴일에는 음악을 감상하러 자주 놀러 가곤 해.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Have you ever worried about the impression you make on others?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What made you ask that all of a sudden?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I mean... I'm sure you've noticed that I look kind of threatening.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I think that's why I keep getting into fights.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's not much good that can come from a bad first impression.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. The item you requested just arrived.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh, it's finally here!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee! Based on your reaction, you must have really been looking forward to this.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you have time this afternoon, stop by the Problem Solver office to pick it up.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll be there as soon as I'm done with my Schale stuff.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is there a particular genre of music you prefer?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Pop, I guess.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Maybe classical?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I see. That's a good choice.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What kind of music do you like, Kayoko?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well... I like normal stuff, so I think our tastes are probably the same.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, did you finish listening to the second album I recommended?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: How was it? Isn't Black Death Poison the best?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It was quite...impressive.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It was quite...avant-garde.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm glad you recognize the value of their music.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Their second album's lyrics are much tamer than their first,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: but the sound is really heavy, so metalheads tend to prefer the second album.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you liked Black Death Poison's second album, I can lend you their third.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I think I've had enough heavy metal for now...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, they say it's gonna rain this afternoon.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't forget your umbrella when you leave home.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've heard there's a massive library in Trinity that has every book in the world...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is there a music store that has every album in the world?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What about the Record Building in Kivotos? The one in the shopping district?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I don't know if it has every album in the world, but it still has a bunch.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They have all kinds of albums across every genre.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I often go there on weekends to listen to their music.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครูเคยกังวลเกี่ยวกับหน้าตาบ้างไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมจู่ๆ ก็ถามแบบนี้ล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็แบบ... ครูก็รู้นี่นาว่าหน้าตาฉันออกไป
ทางดุๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็เลยมีเรื่องชวนทะเลาะกับคนอื่นอยู่เรื่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: การที่หน้าตาดูดุแบบนี้ไม่ใช่เรื่องดีเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เราได้ของที่ได้รับภารกิจให้ตามหาแล้วล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จริงเหรอ? ได้มาแล้วเหรอ!?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ดีใจขนาดนี้ คงจะอยากได้มากเลยสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้ามีเวลาก็ไปรับของที่หน่วยรับจ้าง
สารพัดสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าเสร็จงานที่ชาเล่ต์แล้วครูจะไปทันทีเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครูมีแนวเพลงที่ชอบไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: คิดว่าเพลงป๊อปนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: น่าจะเป็นเพลงคลาสสิก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เป็นคนฟังอะไรง่ายๆ สินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แล้วคาโยโกะล่ะชอบเพลงอะไร?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันเองก็... อืม... ชอบเพลงฟังง่ายๆ
ชอบเหมือนที่ครูชอบเลยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครูฟังเพลงอัลบั้ม 2 ที่ฉันแนะนำไปหรือยัง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพลงของวง 'พิษสีดำแห่งความตาย'
เพราะสุดๆ ไปเลยใช่ไหมล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อืม... เพลงน่าประทับใจดี

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อืม... เพลงล้ำสมัยดี

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
กะแล้วว่าครูต้องเข้าถึงคุณค่าของเพลงนี้
ดีจังที่ครูชอบ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เนื้อเพลงอัลบั้ม 2 ดูเรียบง่ายกว่าอัลบั้ม 1

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่แฟนๆ เฮฟวี่เมทัลชอบดนตรีบีทหนักๆ
แบบนี้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าชอบอัลบั้ม 2 ล่ะก็ เดี๋ยวฉันจะให้ยืม
อัลบั้ม 3 ไปฟังด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: พักเพลงเฮฟวี่เมทัลก่อนดีกว่า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้พยากรณ์อากาศบอกว่าช่วงบ่ายๆ
เย็นๆ ฝนจะตกล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก่อนไปทำงานก็อย่าลืมเอาร่มติดตัวไป
ด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ได้ยินมาว่าในทรีนิตี้มีห้องสมุดใหญ่ที่รวม
หนังสือทั่วทุกมุมโลกเอาไว้ด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จะมีร้านซีดีที่มีอัลบั้มเพลงทั่วโลกบ้าง
มั้ยนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ลองไปร้าน 'เรคคอร์ดบิลดิ้ง' ในย่าน
การค้าคิโวทอสดูสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นี่นั่นดูไม่เลวเลย... แม้จะไม่มีซีดีเพลง
จากทั่วโลกก็เถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะยังไงก็มีซีดีเพลงเยอะ และไม่
จำกัดแนวเพลง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันก็แวะไปฟังเพลงที่นั่นบ่อยๆ

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師有因為自己的外貌苦惱過嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這麼突然，怎麼了？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……如老師知道的那樣，我經常聽人說我給人的第一印象很可怕

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 經常被奇怪的人事糾纏

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 拜此所賜……也沒獲得過什麼好處

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，之前說要找的東西，終於入手了唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 太好了，謝謝！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 看這反應，想必是找很久了。那太好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天下午如果有空的話，可以來便利屋領取

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 夏萊的工作結束後，馬上就去

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師有喜歡的音樂類型嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 流行歌曲吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 古典音樂吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這樣啊，我覺得很適合你

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 佳世子喜歡什麼樣的音樂？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我……普普通通吧。可能跟老師的很接近

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那個第二張專輯，聽完了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 「Black Death Poison」是不是很棒？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……腦袋被狠狠重擊一樣的感覺

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……感覺挺前衛的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不愧是老師，我就知道你懂

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 第二張專輯的歌詞比第一張容易理解

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但聲音更加強烈，所以更多人喜歡這張

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果喜歡的話，下次借你第三張專輯

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我會考慮的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 氣象預報說今天下午會下雨

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不要忘記帶傘唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 三一好像有一座收集了世界上所有書籍的巨大圖書館……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 會不會也有唱片店收集了全世界的唱片呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 商店街的「The．Record Building」如何？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那裡雖說不到全世界……但品項確實挺齊全

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不分種類收集了各種類型的唱片

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我假日常去
